title: ddl-matrix named the truncate case's table TRUNCATE, which SQL Server refuses

found.by: lfc-schema-change-test gateway-staging samples: SQL Server 2022 CU27, standard CDC, utility 1.7, serverless gateway

symptom: ddl-matrix.py sql sqlserver: CREATE TABLE <schema>.truncate fails with Msg 156 (incorrect syntax near the keyword); the run's setup stops at that table
cause: the table is named after the case id, and TRUNCATE is a reserved word in T-SQL
effect: the setup script stops at that table: the truncate case and every statement after it in the batch file don't run
fix: ddl-matrix.py tname(): a case id that is a reserved word gets _table (truncate -> truncate_table), for every engine
